detail.longDescription: We pulled out the semantic layer from our other app (Strata.do) and made it a standalone service. Now anyone can build data apps with an integrated deterministic, secure, and fast query layer. How it works: 1. Use the zsql cli to build your model locally 2. zsql deploy (self hosted versions soon) 3. Post a query spec to your projects end point 4. Get back SQL We never connect to your data warehouse or see any actual data. We only see your model and generate valid sql's. This is an alternative to using Cube, MetricFlow, Semantic Views, and various other solutions. See our comparison table for the key differences: https://www.0sql.io/#compare Thanks for checking it out! What do you think??
